gate1.note: User selected Feature + Autopilot at the front door after being shown the measured root cause. A production BFF session survives exactly one refresh: the Hub rotates its session cookie as __Host-fxl_hub_session in production, and hub-sdk 1.3.1's parseRotatedRefresh regex cannot match a name preceded by '-', so tx.update is never called and the store replays a stale refresh token until the Hub revokes the family with reuse_detected. Invisible locally because the Hub only prefixes the cookie when NODE_ENV=production, which is why three prior browser-side fixes all missed it. Four independent slices in one wave: slice 01 normalizes the rotated cookie name at createHubBff's fetchImpl seam and adds the end-to-end oracle that was missing; slices 02-04 repair the /no-role dead end that earlier fixes turned a lost session into. Gate 2 remains mandatory per slice and per wave. Gate 3 remains human-gated; this run stops at master.

gate1_prior.note: User selected Autopilot at the front door, and pre-answered the one design fork that mattered: keep our own session store, do not adopt SqlHubSessionStore. Six slices in three waves upgrade @fxl-business/hub-sdk to ^1.3.0, port the store to the async transactional withSession contract, add an absolute session lifetime, consume the new refresh-failure classification, and close the logout leak as a defect. Gate 2 remains mandatory per slice and per wave. Gate 3 remains human-gated; this run stops at master.

gate3_hotfix.note: v2.7.0 took production down: hub-sdk 1.3.x added an undocumented CSRF origin guard that 403s every BFF POST when the web app and API are on different hosts, which is this product's topology. Entitled operators saw a blank screen then the session recovery panel. Fixed forward, because rolling back to v2.5.0 was NOT safe - migration 0021 added absolute_expires_at NOT NULL and v2.5.0 code does not write it. Gate 2 PASS by a separate Verify agent with 14 CSRF bypass attempts all rejected. Production CORS_ORIGIN verified against the live API before promoting; the fix confirmed live (403 to 401, browser reached /tatico/dashboard). master == staging == production == e8a5810.
